hero.title: Replies in the customer's language
hero.lede: List the languages your shop speaks. Agents answer in whichever one the customer used, flow messages included.

exactNumbers.title: The numbers stay exact
lede: Flow messages are written once in English. Details are filled in from the order first, then the sentence is translated, so a model never retypes an order or tracking number.

items.title: List your languages
items.text: In Business profile. Fernway listed English and Spanish.

items.title: Add one house rule
items.text: Front desk gets "Reply in the customer's language".

items.title: Test it
items.text: Write to it in Spanish in the customer widget and read what comes back.

tomas.title: What Tomás saw
lede: Tomás wrote in Spanish and got the tracking details back in Spanish in 1.1 seconds. The trace shows the same steps as any other order.

image.alt: A reply in Spanish beside the steps the agents took.

items.question: Which languages have you tested?
items.answer: Spanish, on the test day. The others on this page are examples, and quality depends on the model you run, so read some replies before you turn one on.

items.question: Does it translate my documents?
items.answer: No. The agents read your documents and write their reply in the customer's language.
